description: This file contains utility functions and class definitions for logging attributes related to Langfuse integration with OpenTelemetry in a language model context. It includes functions for extracting response content based on response type and a class for setting observation attributes on tracing spans.

classes.name: LangfuseLLMObsOTELAttributes
classes.description: A class extending BaseLLMObsOTELAttributes to set message and response output attributes for Langfuse logging in OpenTelemetry spans.

methods.name: get_output_content_by_type
methods.description: Extracts output content from various response object types for logging.

methods.name: set_messages
methods.description: Sets the input message attributes on a span, including optional functions and tools.

methods.name: set_response_output_messages
methods.description: Sets the response output content attribute on a span based on response object type.
